name: Garmin Run Singapore 2026
short_description: Garmin Run Singapore 2026 is a half-marathon and 10km race held on October 25, 2026 at Marina Barrage, Singapore.
ai_summary: Garmin Run Singapore 2026 is a half-marathon event organized by Garmin, taking place on October 25, 2026 at Marina Barrage in Singapore. The race offers two distance options: a 21.1km half-marathon and a 10km run, priced at SGD 125 and SGD 105 respectively. Registration has not yet been announced, so prospective participants will need to watch for further updates.
